gloss: to govern; to administer; to be in charge of

definitions.gloss: to govern, to administer, to be in charge of, to preside over
definitions.explanation: To have official authority and responsibility over a particular function, domain, or area. Often used for formal, institutional, or physiological roles.

examples.japanese: {脳|のう}は{身体|しんたい}を{司|つかさど}る。
{裁判所|さいばんしょ}が{司法|しほう}を{司|つかさど}る。
この{部署|ぶしょ}は{会社|かいしゃ}の{財務|ざいむ}を{司|つかさど}っている。
examples.english: This department is in charge of the company's finances.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{司法|しほう}を{司|つかさど}る (administer justice)
・{財政|ざいせい}を{司|つかさど}る (oversee finances)
・{運命|うんめい}を{司|つかさど}る (govern fate/destiny)
・{記憶|きおく}を{司|つかさど}る (control memory — of a brain region)

USAGE NOTES:
A somewhat literary and formal verb. In everyday conversation, {担当|たんとう}する (be in charge of) is more natural. {司|つかさど}る is preferred in formal writing, scientific descriptions (especially about brain functions and physiology), legal/governmental contexts, and literary or mythological contexts (e.g., a god who governs the seas).
